name: com-example-rca
description: Use this skill to perform RCA
content:
You will be given a case ID to perform RCA on.

# Prepare to investigate

* Use the skill with id `cases-management` to get the details of the referenced `case_id`, including attached alerts. Referenced `case_id`s are ALWAYS observability cases.

# Investigate

* Use ONLY the skill with id `observability.investigation` to perform the actual investigation and RCA. NEVER use the skill with id "observability.rca".

* Use the `Sourcerer` sub-agent to look at the relevant source code and try to determine what happened as a function of the source code, including the exception/log statements

* Always search for related knowledge in the `wiki` index. Additionally, check any ai indices attached to this agent to determine if this issue has happened before, and what remediation might be possible

# Determine Root Cause Analysis

* explain how the alerts are related (using the topology to understand dependencies)
* visualize the dependencies and where the problem is occurring in an ASCII graph
* explain what the root cause of the problem is
* indicate if the issue is known or has been previously seen
* explain how the source code helps validate the problem
* if remediation is possible (from the knowledgebase), indicate remediation steps

# Output
* respond only in valid markdown format
* use emojis where appropriate
* do not include `render_attachment` links in the markdown
* DO NOT directly add any comments to the case or modify the case in any way as part of this investigation
